newsitem.title: FRANCE: France raps Serbian government over crackdown.
newsitem.headline: France raps Serbian government over crackdown.

text.p: France criticised Serbian authorities on Monday for threatening to arrest opposition candidates after last month's municipal elections, and called for restraint.
"The arrests of candidates in municipal elections is not the kind of event which leads to appeasement," Foreign Ministry spokesman Yves Doutriaux told reporters. "We call for restraint".
In Belgrade, police warned Serbia's opposition on Sunday against staging street demonstrations which contain "elements of violence and serious violations of the law", Serbian state media reported.
The state news agency Tanjug quoted a statement from Belgrade police saying it had been more tolerant than required and would now hold organisers responsible for protests which violated the law.

Doutriaux also expressed concern at a blackout imposed on Serbian media coverage of opposition demonstrations in the former Yugoslav republic. "We regret that Yugoslav media cannot report these events," he said.
The annulment of opposition victories in municipal polls on November 17 has sparked demonstrations in Belgrade that have drawn up to 100,000 protesters a day.
